'''Yaroslav Igorevich Korolev''' ({{langx|ru|Ярослав Игоревич Королёв}}; born 7 May 1987) is a Russian former professional [[basketball]] player.

==Professional career==
Korolev began his pro career with the Russian club [[BC Avtodor Saratov|Avtodor Saratov]]. Korolev was then selected 12th overall in the [[2005 NBA draft]], by the [[Los Angeles Clippers]]. Korolev played for [[PBC CSKA Moscow|CSKA Moscow]] in the [[Russian Basketball Super League 1|Russian Super League]], before joining the Clippers. On 6 July 2007 the Clippers offered Korolev a contract to remain with the team, but then rescinded their offer in September 2007.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.ocregister.com/sports/clippers-korolev-year-1848581-season-pick|title=Clippers sever ties with Korolev.|access-date=2007-09-21|archive-date=2007-11-03|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071103054058/http://www.ocregister.com/sports/clippers-korolev-year-1848581-season-pick|url-status=dead}}</ref> He then returned to the Clippers during the preseason, on a non-guaranteed contract, but was waived before the season began.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.clipsnation.com/2007/10/2/145931/301|title=Korolev Will Be in Camp|first=Steve|last=Perrin|date=October 2, 2007|website=Clips Nation}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/news/story?id=3079597|title=Clippers waive former first-round pick Korolev|date=October 25, 2007|website=ESPN.com}}</ref>

In December 2007, Korolev signed with [[MBC Dynamo Moscow|Dynamo Moscow]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://admin.euroleague.net/ulebcup/home/news/i/20107/448/dynamo-moscow-inks-yaroslav-korolev|title=Dynamo Moscow inks Yaroslav Korolev.}}</ref> In November 2009, Korolev was drafted in the fourth round of the [[NBDL]], Draft by the [[Albuquerque Thunderbirds]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/draft_board_2009.html|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20101118173714/http://www.nba.com/dleague/draft_board_2009.html|url-status=dead|title=2009 Draft Board.|website=[[NBA.com]] |archivedate=November 18, 2010}}</ref> He was traded to the [[Reno Bighorns]] on 19 January 2010.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/reno/bighorns_acquire_korolev_from__2010_01_19.html|title=Bighorns Acquire Korolev From Albuquerque.|website=[[NBA.com]] }}</ref>

On 26 July 2010 he signed a contract with Spanish club [[CB Granada]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/spain/83543/cb-granada-tabs-yaroslav-korolev.html|title=CB Granada tabs Yaroslav Korolev.}}</ref> In August 2011, he signed with [[San Sebastián Gipuzkoa BC|Lagun Aro GBC]].<ref>[http://www.sportando.net/eng/europe/spain/30422/lagun_aro_lands_yaroslav_korolev.html Lagun Aro lands Yaroslav Korolev.]</ref> In December 2012, he joined [[BC Spartak St. Petersburg|Spartak St. Petersburg]].<ref>[http://en.ria.ru/sports/20121228/178458695/Ex-Clipper_Korolev_Signs_for_Spartak___.html Ex-Clipper Korolev Signs for Spartak.]</ref>

In October 2014, Korolev signed with the [[Greek Basket League|Greek League]] team [[Panionios B.C.|Panionios]] for the 2014–15 season.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.court-side.com/news/blog/yaroslav-korolev-panionios-athens/ |title=Yaroslav Korolev to Panionios Athens. |access-date=2015-02-27 |archive-date=2015-04-02 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150402124259/http://www.court-side.com/news/blog/yaroslav-korolev-panionios-athens/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> On 16 December 2016 Korolev announced his retirement.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/russia/220457/former-clippers-draftee-yaroslav-korolev-retires.html|title=Former Clippers draftee Yaroslav Korolev retires.}}</ref> His last team was [[Basket Navarra Club]], with which he played in 2016.
